scope: Method-level review of three frozen CVPR 2023 leads

records.title: Pointersect: Neural Rendering With Cloud-Ray Intersection
records.reason: A set transformer estimates the ray intersection and local material weights from nearby points. The rendering path traces rays against those intersections. Visibility splatting is a reported comparison baseline.
records.earliest_public_date_status: v1 verified; earlier public evidence not independently ruled out

records.title: NeuralEditor: Editing Neural Radiance Fields via Manipulating Point Clouds
records.reason: The point cloud defines adaptive K-D voxels. Deterministic spline integration and front-to-back volume rendering produce pixel values from the voxel intervals.
records.earliest_public_date_status: v1 verified; earlier public evidence not independently ruled out

records.title: Frequency-Modulated Point Cloud Rendering With Easy Editing
records.reason: Fixed-support projected disks generate nearest-depth estimates in the main renderer, an explicit special case of surface splatting. AFNet predicts radiance using the estimated surface coordinates. The point opacity optimization is a separate preprocessing stage.
records.earliest_public_date_status: v1 verified; earlier public evidence not independently ruled out
